name: mech-6-bounce-pad-room
source: mech-6-bounce-pad Test Level: bounce pad B west of a one-tile void gap V with floor beyond; step on the pad, survive its one-move compression, then the next directional input launches exactly two tiles over the gap. A second pad on the far side points at the wall so a careless launch direction lands badly and loses. The guard from the teaching moment is synergy 37 (not built); that test case is skipped with reason in tools/test_mech_6_bounce_pad.py.
